text:
Situation: Cephalexin 500 mg capsules are low at Corvale East (5 days, 88 units) and Corvale Lakeside (6.2 days, 27 units). Corvale General holds 26.5 days (399 units). No FDA shortage posting, recall, or OAI classification for this product or plant appears in the provided records.

Why (FDA record): FDA's most recent inspection of the plant ended 2024-09-06 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2024-11-13.

Our position: Internal redistribution can cover both sites for at least two weeks. External purchase is available from three suppliers not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Verify current on-hand and daily-use figures at Corvale East, Corvale General, and Corvale Lakeside, and confirm no new FDA actions have been posted since the last inspection date. (Pharmacy buyer)
2. Transfer 157 units from Corvale General to Corvale East. (Pharmacy director approves transfer request)
3. Transfer 31 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside. (Pharmacy director approves transfer request)
4. If transfers cannot be completed, place purchase orders with A-S Medication Solutions, ADVANCED RX PHARMACY OF TENNESSEE, LLC, or AMELLA PHARMA, LLC. (Buyer executes; pharmacy director approves purchase)

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
